Name: Lumisteria Serene Meadow
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds :

- more than 20 crops
- more than 12 giant crops
- one flower trees
- nearly 30 unique gift lines
- more options to obtain some of the crops
- integration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]
- and some unique details.
- dishes and some teas
- you can make the teas in the tea pot from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22376]Uncle Iroh approved tea[/url] (thanks to slimerain for the permission :) )

From people updating from version 1.0.1 to version 1.1.0, pls delete the previous folder. The new folder organisation will be more convenient for me in the future, especially for adding frameworks if needed :)

It is a successor to my Flowers and Crops mod.
It uses Content Patcher to add the new items (which is possible in the 1.6 version of the game).
